<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 138.76, 131.45 (two equivalent carbons), 130.59 (two equivalent carbons), and 121.30 ppm. This accounts for six aromatic carbon atoms, consistent with a single benzene ring.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
